insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
violation_details: Policy active for 6+ years. IRDAI 2024 Master Circular Section 6 explicitly bars denial for pre-existing disease after 5 continuous years (60 months).
matched_precedent: Civil Appeal No. 4092 of 2022 (Manmohan Nanda v. United India Assurance)

cited_clause: Clause 5.14 - Non-active treatment / OPD feasibility & Delayed Intimation
violation_details: Delayed intimation without prejudice to insurer cannot justify total repudiation. Also, treating physician's judgment on admission necessity supersedes insurance desk review.
matched_precedent: Civil Appeal No. 3409 of 2008 (National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Nitin Khandelwal)
